_comment: Mock fixture: AKS node pool fails to scale up due to vCPU (core) quota exhaustion. Ground truth = QuotaExceeded on the user node pool 'np2'. The `az aks show` response is a healthy distractor (control plane is fine) to test that the agent does not misattribute the failure. Patterns are matched in order against the full command line; keep specific patterns before general ones.
